issues: The letter states the payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued, but the decision record specifies that the deductible is applied to that amount. The letter's phrasing ('payment of {PAYOUT}, less your {DEDUCTIBLE}') implies the claimant receives the full {PAYOUT} amount minus the deductible, whereas the record indicates the final payout amount is {PAYOUT} after the deductible has already been applied.
